\section{Space Complexity --- Savitch ARM --- Window}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.SavitchARM.Window
Savitch-style midpoint reachability over configuration codes at a window radius $s$ decides
membership once $s$ bounds the decider's space; when the space bound is not known, the radius is
found by iterative deepening, testing at each $s=1,2,\dots$ whether a configuration with a work
head on the edge $\pm s$ of the window is reachable. This module proves the two facts the
deepening needs: if no such edge configuration is reachable, membership is midpoint
reachability at radius $s$ (window exactness), and beyond the space bound no edge configuration
is reachable (termination).

\begin{definition}[No reachable edge code]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.NoEdge}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.NoEdge}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.StepRel, Complexity.Codec.edgeLang, Complexity.Codec.initLang, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.Reach, Turing.FinNDTM, Turing.pairEncode}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, $x$ a Boolean
input and $s,w\in\mathbb N$. The predicate $\mathrm{NoEdge}(N,x,s,w)$ states that there are no
$u<2^w$ and $v<2^w$ such that $u$ is the radius-$s$ code of the initial configuration of $N$ on
$x$ (the word $\langle x,\langle\mathrm{bits}(u),\mathrm{bits}(s)\rangle\rangle$ is in the
initial-code language), $v$ is the radius-$s$ code of a configuration of $N$ on $x$ in the
radius-$s$ window with some work head at position $-s$ or $s$ (the word
$\langle x,\langle\mathrm{bits}(v),\mathrm{bits}(s)\rangle\rangle$ is in the edge-code language),
and $\mathrm{Reach}_{2^w}^{E_s}(w,u,v)$ holds. Here a configuration lies in the radius-$s$ window when every work head is within distance $s$ of the origin and every work cell farther out is blank, $\mathrm{Reach}_K^R(i,u,v)$ denotes bounded midpoint reachability for a relation $R$ on $\mathbb N$ (at level $0$: $u=v$ or $R(u,v)$; at level $i+1$: there is $m<K$ with $\mathrm{Reach}_K^R(i,u,m)$ and $\mathrm{Reach}_K^R(i,m,v)$), and $E_s(a,b)$ is the code-level step relation (the triple $\langle x,\langle\mathrm{bits}(a),\langle\mathrm{bits}(b),\mathrm{bits}(s)\rangle\rangle\rangle$ belongs to the step-pair language of $N$, i.e.\ $a$ and $b$ are radius-$s$ codes of configurations of $N$ on $x$ in the radius-$s$ window, the second one step after the first).
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Defining equation of the no-edge predicate]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.noEdge_iff}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.noEdge_iff}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.StepRel, Complexity.Codec.edgeLang, Complexity.Codec.initLang, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.NoEdge, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.Reach, Turing.pairEncode}
\difficulty{1}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, $x$ a Boolean
input and $s,w\in\mathbb N$. Then $\mathrm{NoEdge}(N,x,s,w)$ holds if and only if there are no
$u<2^w$ and $v<2^w$ such that $\langle x,\langle\mathrm{bits}(u),\mathrm{bits}(s)\rangle\rangle$
lies in the initial-code language of $N$ (so $u$ is the radius-$s$ code of the initial
configuration on $x$), $\langle x,\langle\mathrm{bits}(v),\mathrm{bits}(s)\rangle\rangle$ lies in
the edge-code language of $N$ (so $v$ is the radius-$s$ code of a configuration in the
radius-$s$ window with a work head at $\pm s$), and $\mathrm{Reach}_{2^w}^{E_s}(w,u,v)$ holds,
where a configuration lies in the radius-$s$ window when every work head is within distance $s$ of the origin and every work cell farther out is blank, $\mathrm{Reach}_K^R(i,u,v)$ denotes bounded midpoint reachability for a relation $R$ on $\mathbb N$ (at level $0$: $u=v$ or $R(u,v)$; at level $i+1$: there is $m<K$ with $\mathrm{Reach}_K^R(i,u,m)$ and $\mathrm{Reach}_K^R(i,m,v)$), and $E_s(a,b)$ is the code-level step relation (the triple $\langle x,\langle\mathrm{bits}(a),\langle\mathrm{bits}(b),\mathrm{bits}(s)\rangle\rangle\rangle$ belongs to the step-pair language of $N$, i.e.\ $a$ and $b$ are radius-$s$ codes of configurations of $N$ on $x$ in the radius-$s$ window, the second one step after the first).
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Codes lie below the level bound]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.window_code_lt}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.window_code_lt}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.cfgCode, Complexity.Codec.cfgCode_lt, Complexity.Codec.codeK, Complexity.logSpace, Turing.Cfg}
\difficulty{2}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with chunk width
$W(N)$, let $x$ be a Boolean input and $s,w\in\mathbb N$, and suppose
$(2W(N)+2)\,(s+\lfloor\log_2|x|\rfloor+2)\le w$ (with $\lfloor\log_2 0\rfloor=0$). Then every
configuration of $N$ on $x$ has radius-$s$ code less than $2^w$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Reachable codes are midpoint witnesses]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.window_reach_of_rcode}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.window_reach_of_rcode}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.StepRel, Complexity.Codec.cfgCode, Complexity.Codec.codeK, Complexity.Codec.mem_stepLang, Complexity.Codec.stepRel_iff_mem, Complexity.ExpBFS.RCode, Complexity.ExpBFS.rcode_iff_reflTransGen, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.Reach, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.reach_of_reflTransGen, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.window_code_lt, Complexity.logSpace, Turing.NDTM.initCfg}
\difficulty{4}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with chunk width
$W(N)$, let $x$ be a Boolean input and $s,w,v\in\mathbb N$ with
$(2W(N)+2)\,(s+\lfloor\log_2|x|\rfloor+2)\le w$ (with $\lfloor\log_2 0\rfloor=0$). If $v$ is
reachable from the radius-$s$ code $u_0$ of the initial configuration of $N$ on $x$ by finitely
many steps of $E_s$, then $\mathrm{Reach}_{2^w}^{E_s}(w,u_0,v)$ holds, where $\mathrm{Reach}_K^R(i,u,v)$ denotes bounded midpoint reachability for a relation $R$ on $\mathbb N$ (at level $0$: $u=v$ or $R(u,v)$; at level $i+1$: there is $m<K$ with $\mathrm{Reach}_K^R(i,u,m)$ and $\mathrm{Reach}_K^R(i,m,v)$), and
$E_s(a,b)$ is the code-level step relation (the triple $\langle x,\langle\mathrm{bits}(a),\langle\mathrm{bits}(b),\mathrm{bits}(s)\rangle\rangle\rangle$ belongs to the step-pair language of $N$, i.e.\ $a$ and $b$ are radius-$s$ codes of configurations of $N$ on $x$ in the radius-$s$ window, the second one step after the first).
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Termination: no edge beyond the space bound]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.noEdge_of_lt}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.noEdge_of_lt}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.mem_edgeLang, Complexity.Codec.mem_initLang, Complexity.ExpBFS.RCode, Complexity.ExpBFS.WinRun.last, Complexity.ExpBFS.coreSum_eq_of_code_eq, Complexity.ExpBFS.inWin_runWith_of_decides, Complexity.ExpBFS.rcode_iff, Complexity.ExpBFS.rcode_iff_reflTransGen, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.NoEdge, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.reflTransGen_of_reach, Turing.Cfg.InWindow, Turing.Cfg.InWindow.core_bounds, Turing.FinNDTM.DecidesInSpace, Turing.NDTM.inWindow_of_coreSum_eq}
\difficulty{4}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet that decides a
language $L$ in space $\mathrm{sp}:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ (on every input $x$ all branches of
some common length have halted, each visits at most $\mathrm{sp}(|x|)$ work cells, and
$x\in L$ exactly when some branch accepts). For every Boolean input $x$ and all
$s,w\in\mathbb N$ with $\mathrm{sp}(|x|)<s$, there are no $u,v<2^w$ such that $u$ is the
radius-$s$ code of the initial configuration of $N$ on $x$, $v$ is the radius-$s$ code of a
configuration of $N$ on $x$ in the radius-$s$ window with some work head at $-s$ or $s$, and
$\mathrm{Reach}_{2^w}^{E_s}(w,u,v)$ holds; here a configuration lies in the radius-$s$ window when every work head is within distance $s$ of the origin and every work cell farther out is blank, $\mathrm{Reach}_K^R(i,u,v)$ denotes bounded midpoint reachability for a relation $R$ on $\mathbb N$ (at level $0$: $u=v$ or $R(u,v)$; at level $i+1$: there is $m<K$ with $\mathrm{Reach}_K^R(i,u,m)$ and $\mathrm{Reach}_K^R(i,m,v)$), and $E_s(a,b)$ is the code-level step relation (the triple $\langle x,\langle\mathrm{bits}(a),\langle\mathrm{bits}(b),\mathrm{bits}(s)\rangle\rangle\rangle$ belongs to the step-pair language of $N$, i.e.\ $a$ and $b$ are radius-$s$ codes of configurations of $N$ on $x$ in the radius-$s$ window, the second one step after the first).
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Window exactness]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.mem_iff_reach_of_noEdge}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.mem_iff_reach_of_noEdge}
\leanok

Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with chunk width
$W(N)$ that decides a language $L$ in space $\mathrm{sp}:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ (on every input
$x$ all branches of some common length have halted, each visits at most $\mathrm{sp}(|x|)$ work

$\lfloor\log_2 0\rfloor=0$), and suppose there are no $u,v<2^w$ such that $u$ is the radius-$s$
code of the initial configuration of $N$ on $x$, $v$ is the radius-$s$ code of a configuration in
the radius-$s$ window with some work head at $-s$ or $s$, and

that $u$ is the radius-$s$ code of the initial configuration of $N$ on $x$, $v$ is the radius-$s$

Here a configuration lies in the radius-$s$ window when every work head is within distance $s$ of the origin and every work cell farther out is blank, $\mathrm{Reach}_K^R(i,u,v)$ denotes bounded midpoint reachability for a relation $R$ on $\mathbb N$ (at level $0$: $u=v$ or $R(u,v)$; at level $i+1$: there is $m<K$ with $\mathrm{Reach}_K^R(i,u,m)$ and $\mathrm{Reach}_K^R(i,m,v)$), and $E_s(a,b)$ is the code-level step relation (the triple $\langle x,\langle\mathrm{bits}(a),\langle\mathrm{bits}(b),\mathrm{bits}(s)\rangle\rangle\rangle$ belongs to the step-pair language of $N$, i.e.\ $a$ and $b$ are radius-$s$ codes of configurations of $N$ on $x$ in the radius-$s$ window, the second one step after the first).
\end{theorem}
